hero.title: PMU Training Courses
hero.text: Become a certified permanent makeup artist. Our courses combine theory, live demonstrations and plenty of hands-on practice under the guidance of experienced trainers.

intro.title: Learn from certified specialists
intro.text: From beginner course to masterclass — at IZZI Academy you learn everything you need to work independently and professionally. Might you qualify for UWV subsidy (a Dutch reskilling scheme)? Ask us during your consultation.
